SLT Line 202 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Sava (Fare Zone 2). This line has 10 stops, and runs between College Street and West Shoal.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Gallery
  • 6 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 202 mainly the serves Sava Coast and Sava Canyon sub-districts in Sava, and is currently km long.

This line is Line Number 202 in the SLT system, and is represented by Purple (The representative color of Sava Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • At the section after Innercoast River, this line enters a circular single-track section that runs in parallel with Line 201. However, while Line 201 runs in the counter-clockwise direction in the circular section, this line runs in the clockwise direction in that section.

SLT Line 203 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Sava (Fare Zone 2). This line has 7 stops, and runs between Downwell Sand DT Station and Sava Coast NR Station.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Future Development
  • 3 History
  • 4 List of Stations
  • 5 Rolling Stock
  • 6 Gallery
  • 7 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 203 mainly serves Sava Coast and Wellsand in Sava.

This line is Line Number 203 in the SLT system, and is represented by Purple (The representative color of Sava Fare Zone).

Future Development[]

  • This line will extend to West Shoal Stop in the future alongside Line 202 and Line 205. Moreover, plans are in place for this line to extend to Southend and Upwell Sand.

History[]

  • May 16 2020: The section between Downwell Sand DT Station and Sava Coast NR Station began services.

SLT Line 204 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Sava (Fare Zone 2). This line has 4 stops, and runs between Savaria Park and Sayler Depot.

Description[]

SLT Line 204 mainly serves Sava Canyon and Southend in Sava.

This line is Line Number 204 in the SLT system, and is represented by Purple (The representative color of Sava Fare Zone).

History[]

  • January 24 2017: The section between Savaria Park and Southend NR Station began services.
  • August 2021: This line extends to Sayler Depot Stop.

Description []

SLT Line 205 will serve the northwest area of Sava.

This line will be Line Number 205 in the SLT system, and will be represented by Purple (The representative color of Sava Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

Line 205 will use Minecart throughout.

SLT Line 210 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit between Los Sengas Downtown (Fare Zone 1) and Sava (Fare Zone 2). This line has 9 stops, and runs between Ringcrown and Maysang West NR Station.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 History
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Gallery
  • 6 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 210 mainly serves Downtown and Sava.

This line is Line Number 210 in the SLT system, and is represented by Purple (The representative color of Sava Fare Zone).

History[]

  • August 8 2021: This line is established. The section between Yukon Bridge and High Approach NR Station began services.
  • August 16 2022: This line extends to Ringcrown. Eastern extension complete.
  • June 7 2025: This line extends from Yukon Bridge to Maysang West NR Station.

SLT Line 211 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Sava (Fare Zone 2). This line has 8 stops, and runs between Kofu Street and Pisces Pond NR Station.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 History
  • 4 List of Stations
  • 5 Rolling Stock
  • 6 Gallery
  • 7 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 211 mainly serves the Threeler area in Sava.

This line is Line Number 211 in the SLT system, and is represented by Purple (The representative color of Sava Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • At the section after Vayler North NR Station, this line enters a circular single-track section that runs in parallel with Line 104. However, while Line 104 runs in the clockwise direction in the circular section, this line runs in the counter-clockwise direction in that section.

History[]

  • January 23 2021: The section between Kofu Street and Vayler North NR Station commenced services.
  • August 8 2021: This line extends to Pisces Pond NR Station Stop.

Description[]

SLT Line 2301 is a line that runs along the south of Jupiter.

This line is Line Number 2301 in the SLT system, and is represented by Dark Yellow (The representative color of Jupiter Fare Zone).

Description []

SLT Line 2301P will serve Jupiter.

This line will be Line Number 2301P in the SLT system, and will be represented by Dark Yellow (The representative color of Jupiter Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • While this line has yet to be established, reserved platforms for this line are seen at Freedom Bay Stop.

SLT Line 2302 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Jupiter (Fare Zone 23). It currently has 7 stops.

Description[]

SLT Line 2302 is a line that runs along the north coast of Jupiter.

This line is Line Number 2302 in the SLT system, and is represented by Dark Yellow (The representative color of Jupiter Fare Zone).

History[]

The original route of this line runs from Entryway Coast to Quad-Entryway before going to Edtress Pond, but due to road widening works at that vicinity, only the Edtress Pond section of the original line is in operation. However, subsequent development of this line saw the line being connected between Entryway Coast and Quad Entryway once again. However, the current line no longer goes to Lower Quad-Entryway Estate, and instead passes through the QUA-CHC, Harma Coast and Harma stops.

Description []

SLT Line 2305 is a line that aims to connect the Pinestand and Galactic River areas of Jupiter.

This line is Line Number 2305 in the SLT system, and is represented by Dark Yellow (The representative color of Jupiter Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • Prior to theJupiter SLT redevelopment, reserved platforms for this line were seen at Doublewood North. However, the reserved platforms have since been relocated to Callisto Stop

SLT Line 2321 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Jupiter (Fare Zone 23). It currently has 4 stops.

Description[]

SLT Line 2321 is a line that runs along the south of Jupiter.

This line is Line Number 2321 in the SLT system, and is represented by Dark Yellow (The representative color of Jupiter Fare Zone).

Fun facts[]

  • Prior to Jupiter SLT redevelopment, this line planned to have four stations, three of which were elevated. However, all the old stations along this line were demolished during redevelopmment.

Description[]

SLT Line 2410 is a line that runs along the east of Oasis Bay in Snipe Valley.

This line is Line Number 2410 in the SLT system, and is represented by Green Cyan (The representative color of Oasis Fare Zone).

Description []

SLT Line 2601 is a line that runs between southeast Cometsilk and southwest Prymea.

This line is Line Number 2601 in the SLT system, and is represented by Turquoise (The representative color of Prymea Fare Zone).

SLT Line 2610L is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Prymea (Fare Zone 26). It currently has four stops.

Description []

SLT Line 2610L is a line that runs within the Rice Lake area of Prymea.

This line is Line Number 2610L in the SLT system, and is represented by Turquoise (The representative color of Prymea Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • Reserved platforms for this line are also seen at Oblique Spit EHT Station Stop. The Letter "L", as well as the single-platform layout of both that station and Rice Lake EHT Station Stop, also implies that this line will run in a circular fashion similar to that of SLT Line 1L.

SLT Line 2611 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Prymea (Fare Zone 26) and Cometsilk (Fare Zone 17). This line currently has two sections totalling 21 stops, with the south section running between Spring Point and Rice Lake South, and the north section running between Rice Lake Northern Bay and NR Nail Bight Checkpoint.

Description []

SLT Line 2611 is a line that runs between southeast Prymea and the Nail Bight vicinity within Cometsilk.

This line is Line Number 2611 in the SLT system, and is represented by Turquoise (The representative color of Prymea Fare Zone).

SLT Line 2800 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Snowty (Fare Zone 28) and Intus Aquilo (Fare Zone 34). It currently has 9 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2800 is a line that runs between northwest Snowty and northeast Intus Aquilo, passing through the Bamboo Lake vicinity in the process.

This line is Line Number 2800 in the SLT system, and is represented by Magenta (The representative color of Snowty Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • This is the first SLT line in Los Sengas that makes use of the number "00" as its line number.
  • This is the first SLT line that supports Through Services at both ends (Line 3129 to the north and Line INN-04 or Line INN-08 to the south), as well as Through Services towards more than one line at any given end.

SLT Line 2905 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Snowty (Fare Zone 28) and Asylum (Fare Zone 29). It currently has 15 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2905 is a line that runs between northwest Snowty and the Tin Wing area of Asylum.

This line is Line Number 2905 in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to Line 505.[1]

SLT Line 2906 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Asylum (Fare Zone 29). It currently has 15 stops.

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts

  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2906 is a line that runs between the Lumin Glen and Tin Wing Sub-Districts of Asylum.

This line is Line Number 2906 in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to the now defunct Line 506.[1]

SLT Line 2906P is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Asylum (Fare Zone 29). It currently has 18 stops.

Description[]

SLT Line 2906P is a line that runs between the Lumin Glen and Wah Tin Sub-Districts of Asylum.

This line is Line Number 2906P in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to Line 506P.[1]

SLT Line 2907 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Snowty (Fare Zone 28) and Asylum (Fare Zone 29). It currently has 18 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2907 is a line that runs between northwest Snowty and the Tin Wing area of Asylum.

This line is Line Number 2907 in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to Line 507.[1]

SLT Line 2907P is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Snowty (Fare Zone 28) and Asylum (Fare Zone 29). It currently has 21 stops.

Description[]

SLT Line 2907P is a line that runs between northwest Snowty and the Wah Tin Sub-District of Asylum.

This line is Line Number 2907P in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to Line 507P.[1]

SLT Line 2910 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Asylum (Fare Zone 29) and Winsol (Fare Zone 30). It currently has 44 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2910 is a line that runs from the Lumin Glen Sub-District in Asylum to the Maritime Vista Sub-District in Winsol, passing through Hazelboard, Melody, Tin Wing, Exalt Gardens, Brighton Hall, Stronglad, Hawynveil, Field Joy, Fine Woods, Celestial Terrace and Mayfair Garden in the process.

This line is Line Number 2910 in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to Line 610.[1]
  • At 44 Stops, this line is the longest line among all existing SLT Lines.

SLT Line 2914 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Asylum (Fare Zone 29) and Winsol (Fare Zone 30). It currently has 40 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2914 is a line that runs from the Maritime Vista Sub-District in Snowty to the Wah Tin Sub-District in Asylum, passing through Mayfair Garden, Celestial Terrace, Fine Woods, Field Joy, Hawynveil, Stronglad, Brighton Hall, Exalt Gardens, Tin Wing and Arctic Sea in the process.

This line is Line Number 2914 in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to Line 614.[1]
  • Similar to this line, Line 2915 also runs between Maritime Vista and Wah Tin (North). However, while this line passes through Brighton Hall Town Centre, Line 2915 passes through Ayamai.

SLT Line 2914P is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Snowty (Fare Zone 28) and Asylum (Fare Zone 29). It currently has 26 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2914P is a line that runs between northwest Snowty and the Wah Tin Sub-District of Asylum.

This line is Line Number 2914P in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to Line 614P.[1]
  • Similar to this line, Line 2915P also runs between Magma Line and Wah Tin (North). However, while this line passes through Brighton Hall Town Centre, Line 2915P passes through Ayamai.

SLT Line 2915 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Asylum (Fare Zone 29) and Winsol (Fare Zone 30). It currently has 35 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2915 is a line that runs from the Maritime Vista Sub-District in Snowty to the Wah Tin Sub-District in Asylum.

This line is Line Number 2915 in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to Line 615.[1]
  • Similar to this line, Line 2914 also runs between Maritime Vista and Wah Tin (North). However, while this line passes through Ayamai, Line 2914 passes through Brighton Hall Town Centre.

SLT Line 2915P is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Snowty (Fare Zone 28) and Asylum (Fare Zone 29). It currently has 22 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2915P is a line that runs between northwest Snowty and the Wah Tin Sub-District of Asylum.

This line is Line Number 2915P in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to Line 615P.[1]
  • Similar to this line, Line 2914P also runs between Magma Line and Wah Tin (North). However, while this line passes through Ayamai, Line 2914P passes through Brighton Hall Town Centre.

SLT Line 2951 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Asylum (Fare Zone 29). It currently has 30 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2951 is a line that runs between the Celestial Terrace Sub-District and the Wah Tin Sub-District in Asylum.

This line is Line Number 2951 in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to Line 751.[1]
  • This line has plans to extend to East Point Bay and Cozywood from each respective end in the future.

SLT Line 2961P is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Asylum (Fare Zone 29) and Winsol (Fare Zone 30). It currently has 8 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2961P is a line that runs from the Maritime Vista Sub-District in Snowty to the Celestial Terrace Sub-District in Asylum.

This line is Line Number 2961P in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to Line 761P.[1]
  • This line has plans to extend to East Point Bay in the future.

SLT Line 2970 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Snowty (Fare Zone 28) and Asylum (Fare Zone 29). It currently has 19 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2970 is a line that runs between northwest Snowty and the Celestial Terrace Sub-District of Asylum.

This line is Line Number 2970 in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to Line 720.[1]
  • This line has plans to extend to East Point Bay in the future.

SLT Line 2972 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Snowty (Fare Zone 28) and Asylum (Fare Zone 29). It currently has 28 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2972 is a line that runs between northwest Snowty and the Celestial Terrace Sub-District of Asylum.

This line is Line Number 2972 in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to the now defunct Line 722.[1]
  • This line has plans to extend to East Point Bay in the future.

SLT Line 2975 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Snowty (Fare Zone 28) and Asylum (Fare Zone 29). It currently has 23 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2975 is a line that runs between around the Field Joy vicinity in Asylum.

This line is Line Number 2975 in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to Line 705 with regards that both lines run in a counterclockwise fashion.[1]

SLT Line 2976 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Snowty (Fare Zone 28) and Asylum (Fare Zone 29). It currently has 23 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 2976 is a line that runs between around the Field Joy vicinity in Asylum.

This line is Line Number 2976 in the SLT system, and is represented by Pale Blue (The representative color of Asylum Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The numbering of the SLT Lines in Asylum pays tribute to the Light Rail System operated by the MTR in Hong Kong. This Line corresponds to Line 706 with regards that both lines run in a clockwise fashion.[1]

SLT Line 301 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Katadelphia (Fare Zone 3). This line currently has 4 stops, and runs between One Origin and Po Tat Estate.

Description[]

SLT Line 301 mainly serves the southwest area of Katadelphia.

This line is Line Number 301 in the SLT system, and is represented by Light Green (The representative color of Katadelphia Fare Zone).

SLT Line 301L is a proposed line of Sava Light Transit.

Contents

  • 2 Fun Facts

  • 4 Gallery
  • 5 Citations and References

Description []

SLT Line 301L will serve the northwest area of Katadelphia.

This line will be Line Number 301L in the SLT system, and will be represented by Light Green (The representative color of Katadelphia Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • While this line has yet to be established, reserved platforms for this line are seen at Po Tat Estate Stop alongside Line 302L, where it also interchanges with Line 301.


Rolling Stock[]

Line 301L will use Minecart throughout.

SLT Line 302L is a proposed line of Sava Light Transit.

Contents

  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 Rolling Stock
  • 4 Gallery
  • 5 Citations and References

Description []

SLT Line 302L will serve the northwest area of Katadelphia.

This line will be Line Number 302L in the SLT system, and will be represented by Light Green (The representative color of Katadelphia Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • While this line has yet to be established, reserved platforms for this line are seen at Po Tat Estate Stop alongside Line 301L, where it also interchanges with Line 301.


Rolling Stock[]

Line 302L will use Minecart throughout.

SLT Line 3101 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Coopol (Fare Zone 31). It currently has two stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 List of Stations
  • 3 Rolling Stock
  • 4 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 3101 is a line that runs within the Key River area in Coopol. It provides connection services to and from Key River Station of Glacier Line and the Keysnowey Hot Spring Hotel nearby.

This line is Line Number 3101 in the SLT system, and is represented by Moonstone Blue (The representative color of Coopol Fare Zone).

SLT Line 3102 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Coopol (Fare Zone 31). It currently has three stops.

Contents

  • 2 List of Stations
  • 3 Rolling Stock
  • 4 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 3102 is a line that runs within the Trisnow area of Coopol and has plans to serve the Trisnow Resort Area.

This line is Line Number 3102 in the SLT system, and is represented by Moonstone Blue (The representative color of Coopol Fare Zone).

SLT Line 3111 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Coopol (Fare Zone 31). It currently has four stops.

  • 2 List of Stations
  • 3 Rolling Stock
  • 4 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 3111 is a line that runs between the Glaciss and Trisnow areas in Coopol.

This line is Line Number 3111 in the SLT system, and is represented by Moonstone Blue (The representative color of Coopol Fare Zone).

SLT Line 3129 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Coopol (Fare Zone 31) and Snowty (Fare Zone 28). It currently has 13 stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 3129 is a line that runs between southeast Asylum and the Brighton Hall area of Asylum, passing through southeast Coopol in the process, before terminating at east Snowty at Country Park Stop.

This line is Line Number 3129 in the SLT system, and is represented by Moonstone Blue (The representative color of Coopol Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The Line Number stems from the fact that this line mainly passes through Coopol (Fare Zone 31) and Asylum (Fare Zone 29). However, noticeably, one of its stops, Country Park Stop, is located within Snowty (Fare Zone 28).

SLT Line 3301 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit between Los Sengas Jupiter (Fare Zone 23) and Paloros (Fare Zone 33). It currently has five stops.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 List of Stations
  • 3 Rolling Stock
  • 4 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 3301 is a line that runs within the vicinity of Markost, which belongs to Jupiter but is located at the same continent as Paloros, before proceeding south to Paloros.

This line is Line Number 3301 in the SLT system, and is represented by Blue (The representative color of Paloros Fare Zone).

This line is Line Number 3303 in the SLT system, and is represented by Blue (The representative color of Paloros Fare Zone).

Description[]

SLT Line 3501 is a line that runs along the Fishpond Vale and Dragonire Bay areas of Odyssey.

This line is Line Number 3501 in the SLT system, and is represented by Purple (The representative color of Odyssey Fare Zone).

SLT Line 3511 is a proposed line of Sava Light Transit.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 Rolling Stock
  • 4 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 3511 will serve the south area of Odyssey.

This line will be Line Number 3511 in the SLT system, and will be represented by Purple (The representative color of Odyssey Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • While this line has yet to be established, reserved platforms for this line are seen at Helios Pier Stop and Hysan Place Stop, and it is implied that this line might also serve Helios Pier North Stop. However, the Platform Markings for Helios Pier Stop may be misattributed to this line instead of Line 3513.[1]

Rolling Stock[]

Line 3511 will use Minecart throughout.

Citations and References[]

This line is Line Number 3512 in the SLT system, and is represented by Purple (The representative color of Odyssey Fare Zone).

SLT Line 3515 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Odyssey (Fare Zone 35). This line circles the Anderson area in Helios in a counter-clockwise direction, and starts at Hei Yee.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 3515 is a circular line that runs within the Helios area of Odyssey.

This line is Line Number 3515 in the SLT system, and is represented by Purple (The representative color of Odyssey Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The route of this line overlaps entirely with Line 3516 starting from Hei Yee Stop. However, while this line runs in the counter-clockwise direction, Line 3516 runs in the clockwise direction.

SLT Line 3516 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Odyssey (Fare Zone 35). This line circles the Anderson area in Helios in a clockwise direction, and starts at Hei Yee.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations
  • 4 Rolling Stock
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 3516 is a circular line that runs within the Helios area of Odyssey.

This line is Line Number 3516 in the SLT system, and is represented by Purple (The representative color of Odyssey Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The route of this line overlaps entirely with Line 3516 starting from Hei Yee Stop. However, while this line runs in the clockwise direction, Line 3515 runs in the counter-clockwise direction.

SLT Line 3521 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Odyssey (Fare Zone 35). This line circles the Egret Docks Vicinity in Odyssey in a counter-clockwise direction, and starts at Hotwellsham NR Station.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations (First Incarnation)
  • 4 List of Stations
  • 5 Rolling Stock
  • 6 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 3521 is a circular line that runs within the Egret Docks and Sirius areas of Odyssey.

This line is Line Number 3521 in the SLT system, and is represented by Purple (The representative color of Odyssey Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The original route of this line overlapped entirely with Line 3522 starting from Egret Docks Stop. However, while this line ran in the counter-clockwise direction, Line 3522 ran in the clockwise direction. Currently, this line runs in a similar fashion to the Toei Ōedo Line and SLT Line 1L, with the branch ending in Hotwellsham NR Station Stop and the circular section running in the counter-clockwise direction.

SLT Line 3522 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Odyssey (Fare Zone 35). This line circles the Egret Docks Vicinity in Odyssey in a clockwise direction, and starts at Bellatrix Terminus.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of Stations (First Incarnation)
  • 4 List of Stations
  • 5 Rolling Stock
  • 6 Citations and References

Description[]

SLT Line 3522 is a circular line that runs within the Bellatrix, Egret Docks and Sirius areas of Odyssey.

This line is Line Number 3522 in the SLT system, and is represented by Purple (The representative color of Odyssey Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • The original route of this line overlapped entirely with Line 3521 starting from Egret Docks Stop. However, while this line ran in the clockwise direction, Line 3521 ran in the counter-clockwise direction. Currently, this line runs in a similar fashion to the Toei Ōedo Line and SLT Line 202, with the branch ending in Bellatrix Terminus Stop and the circular section running in the clockwise direction.

  • 2 Fun Facts

Description[]

SLT Line 3523 will serve the northeast of Odyssey.

This line will be Line Number 3523 in the SLT system, and will be represented by Purple (The representative color of Odyssey Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • While this line has yet to be established, reserved platforms for this line are seen at Egret Docks Stop.

Rolling Stock[]

Line 3523 will use Minecart throughout.

SLT Line 3801 is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Prymea (Fare Zone 26) . It currently has 2 stops.

Description []

SLT Line 3801 is a line that runs within the Lake Yore vicinity of Prymea near Borealis.

This line is Line Number 3801 in the SLT system, and is represented by Sky Blue (The representative color of Borealis Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • While this line currently runs entirely within Prymea, as the vicinity of Prymea is developed by the developer of Borealis and has plans to extend into Borealis in the future, it is considered part of the Borealis SLT network.

Description []

SLT Line 3803 is a line that runs within southeast Prymea near Borealis.

This line is Line Number 3803 in the SLT system, and is represented by Sky Blue (The representative color of Borealis Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • While this line currently runs entirely within Prymea, as the vicinity of Prymea is developed by the developer of Borealis and has plans to extend into Borealis in the future, it is considered part of the Borealis SLT network.
  • This line has plans to extend to Spring Point Stop to the west in the future.

SLT Line 3830L is a line operated by Sava Light Transit within Los Sengas Prymea (Fare Zone 26) . It currently has 5 stops.

Description []

SLT Line 3830L is a line that runs within the Lowwwind vicinity of Prymea near Borealis.

This line is Line Number 3830L in the SLT system, and is represented by Sky Blue (The representative color of Borealis Fare Zone).

Fun Facts[]

  • While this line currently runs entirely within Prymea, as the vicinity of Prymea is developed by the developer of Borealis and has plans to extend into Borealis in the future, it is considered part of the Borealis SLT network.
  • The route of this line overlaps entirely with Line 3840L. However, while this line runs in the counter-clockwise direction, Line 3840L runs in the clockwise direction.
